evidence.quote: It is a fitting time to share some reflections on the importance of the day-to-day work of bank supervision and the steps we are taking to improve the speed, force, and agility of supervision.
The banking system is sound and resilient, and supervisors have been on the frontlines to help ensure it remains that way.
The reduced demand for office space and higher interest rates have put pressure on some CRE valuations, particularly in the office sector.
